This '''species''' was a [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]] that existed in [[the galaxy]].<ref name="TFA" />

==Biology and appearance==
This [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]] was distinguished by their tall masks.<ref name="TFA" />

==Species in the galaxy==
During the reign of the [[Galactic Empire]], in [[5 BBY]], a member of this species visited the [[planet]] [[Ferrix]], walking around the streets of [[Ferrix City]] shortly before the [[Consolidated Holdings of Preox-Morlana Corporation]] [[Pre-Mor Authority Security Forces|agent]] [[Syril Karn]] arrived.<ref name="Andor">{{Andor|Kassa (episode)}}</ref> Later, in [[9 ABY]],<ref name="MandoDate">{{MandoDate|11}}</ref> another member of this species could be found on the [[moon]] of [[Trask]], present on the port where [[Frog Lady]] and [[Frog Man]] reunited.<ref name="Mando">{{TheMandalorian|Chapter 11: The Heiress}}</ref> Even later, in [[34 ABY]],<ref name="TFA Date">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]''</ref> yet another member of this species was present at [[Niima Outpost]] on [[Jakku]] when the [[First Order]] arrived in search of the [[droid]] [[BB-8]].<ref name="TFA" />

{{Species-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Unidentified-Species-Niima-Outpost.png|thumb|right|250px|Outpost Alien C015 by Jake Lunt Davies]]
The species made their debut in the [[2015]] film ''[[Star Wars: Episode VII The Force Awakens]]'', directed by [[J.J. Abrams]].<ref name="TFA" /> They were designed by concept artist [[Jake Lunt Davies]].<ref name="Art Book">''[[The Art of Star Wars: The Force Awakens]]''</ref>
